body:
Two ordering nits in _apply_item's expense-list checks (server/src/shoppinglist_server/sync.py):

1. _check_expense_against_list rejects `"expense": null` on an expenses list before it compares clocks, so a stale write that sets the expense to null is refused with 422 invalid_expense rather than discarded. AGENTS.md's rule is that sync rules apply only to a write that would win; a stale write is discarded silently. No client sends null there, so this is consistency rather than a live bug.

2. _check_expense_against_list runs before the list_closed check, so on a closed list a row whose expense breaks the participant rule reports invalid_expense, not list_closed. Android's SyncEngine keys its "drop the local row and re-pull" handling on list_closed and would quarantine such a row instead. Same for a new item without an expense on a closed list.

Fix: check list_closed first (nothing on a closed list is worth validating further), and apply the null-expense rule only to a winning write. Add server tests for both orderings.
title: Server: expense-list check ordering — stale null expense refused, invalid_expense reported before list_closed
